title: IAD-Unify: Task-Specific Interfaces for Industrial Anomaly Understanding, Segmentation, and Generation
abstract: arXiv:2604.12440v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Industrial anomaly inspection requires complementary capabilities: explaining an observed defect, localizing its pixels, and synthesizing a controlled edit. We present IAD-Unify, a unified architecture connecting a multimodal language model (MLLM), dense visual expert, and diffusion editor through task-specific token interfaces. A multi-reference DINOv2 pathway forms a dense anomaly field and compresses its 1,369 cells into 81 structured evidence tokens. Qwen3.5 consumes these tokens for grounded answers and, with 32 task tokens, converts them into a semantic residual over the dense mask. A separate 256-query interface resamples Qwen states into Stable Diffusion's complete cross-attention context, while the editor retains its source latent and hard-mask inputs. translated_title: IAD-Unify：面向工业异常理解、分割与生成的任务专用接口
translated_abstract: 工业异常检测需要互补的能力：解释观察到的缺陷、定位其像素位置，以及合成受控的编辑。我们提出了 IAD-Unify，这是一种统一架构，通过任务专用的 token 接口连接多模态语言模型（MLLM）、密集视觉专家模块和扩散编辑器。多参考 DINOv2 通路构建一个密集异常场，并将其 1,369 个单元压缩为 81 个结构化证据 token。Qwen3.5 利用这些 token 生成有依据的回答，并通过 32 个任务 token 将其转换为叠加在密集掩码之上的语义残差。一个独立的 256 查询接口将 Qwen 状态重采样为 Stable Diffusion 的完整交叉注意力上下文，同时编辑器保留其源隐变量和硬掩码输入。各任务通路共享同一个 Qwen 适配，而无需强迫每个任务经过相同的视觉瓶颈；特别地，证据 token 被排除在生成过程之外。
tldr: 提出 IAD-Unify 统一架构，通过任务专用 token 接口连接多模态语言模型、密集视觉专家和扩散编辑器，首次将工业异常的解释、像素级分割与受控生成三种互补能力整合于同一框架。
en_tdlr: IAD-Unify is a unified architecture that connects an MLLM, a dense visual expert, and a diffusion editor through task-specific token interfaces, jointly enabling industrial anomaly explanation, pixel-level segmentation, and controlled generation within one framework.
